subject: Requesting short micro-bridge while PO is in vendor audit
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie@medivent.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medivent.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short runway extension while PO is under vendor audit

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited by the latency and cost numbers. Procurement started our external vendor audit today and has put the PO on hold for a few business days while they reconcile a third-party compliance questionnaire.

We expect a resolution in ~7–10 business days, but that window could tighten. We have active integrations and a small pilot workload running that will drop to zero if the account hits the timer cutoff. Can Redwood do a short bridge (either a small temporary credit or a brief trial extension) to keep the pilot live while procurement finishes their audit?

Key details:
- Pilot: Medivent NLP triage (3 seats, low steady traffic)
- Current trial expire: 2027-12-06 23:59 PT
- Expected PO clearance: roughly 2027-12-13 (subject to audit result)

We can sign a short confirmation note w/ conditions if needed. I've attached the draft PO for reference (PO_draft_medivent.pdf).

Appreciate any quick help — keeping the pilot running is important to maintain momentum with our clinical leads.

Best,
Sophie Park
Head of Clinical Ops
Medivent

Attachment: PO_draft_medivent.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Park <sophie@medivent.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short runway extension while PO is under vendor audit

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the context and for sending the draft PO. I looped Marissa and Ben to fast-track approval on our side. We don't like to leave pilots dead in the water. Two options from here that we can move on quickly:

1) Temporary micro-credits: We can provision a one-time 5,000-token credit (estimate ~3–5 days of your current usage) immediately to keep the integration running.

2) Short trial extension: We can extend the trial window 7 days (to 2027-12-13) conditioned on receiving the PO draft and a follow-up confirmation once procurement clears.

If either option works, reply with your preference and confirm who on your side will sign the short confirmation note (we can supply a one-paragraph attestation). If you need something in writing for procurement, say the word and I'll attach the internal approval note.

cc'ing Marissa and Ben to confirm finance/legal are OK with the bridge.

—Connor
